about: DRAFT suggested by Claude for the student to check. Answer key and display order for the test list: 16 stock-related + 4 spy articles, all collected by the rule, at most 3 per source (one exception, marked source_limit_exception: 9to5Mac has 4). Excerpts are at least 140 words for stock-related articles and at least 180 words for spies. The app shows exactly these ids in this order. role, category, spy_type and spy_clue are for checking answers only and are never shown, logged or sent to the LLM. Spies are collected articles whose excerpt shows they are not about the business or the stock (a deal, a film, a history column, a games lineup). spy_clue is the excerpt sentence that shows this. Edit by hand to swap articles.
